The Collector

3000 goldFinished item

A crit item with attack damage and lethality that kills champions instantly below 5% health and gives 25 extra gold per kill.

Stats

  • 50 Attack Damage
  • 10 Lethality
  • 25% Critical Strike Chance

What it does

Death: Your damage executes champions that are below 5% Health.

Taxes: Champion kills grant 25 bonus gold.

When to buy it

Buy it on marksmen who want strong early damage to win fights and secure kills.

Good on

Miss Fortune Caitlyn Draven Jhin Tristana Twitch

Builds from

Pickaxe Serrated Dirk Cloak of Agility

In our champion builds

Caitlyn BotSituational: first-item alternative for early lethality and execute
Draven BotSituational: alternative 2nd item to snowball with execute
Jhin BotSituational: first-item alternative to Hubris
Miss Fortune BotCore item #2

When our guides switch to it

Squishy enemy team: Jhin, Ashe, Caitlyn, Draven, Jinx
